protocol.method_order: alternating first method by position in frozen shuffled task list
protocol.infra_guard: pause on harness exception, unfinished result, low disk, credential error; never replay completed trials

budgets.wall_time: original task agent/verifier limits; common 40s delivery reserve

protocol.history: actual chronological command/output history retained in both arms
protocol.success: official Harbor verifier reward == 1.0 without harness exception; raw reward retained; internal submit is not success
protocol.redundancy: detected reusable-evidence calls / all actual CLI calls; unknown count reported; not a causal savings claim
protocol.rounds: actual CLI feedback batches; decision turns and model requests reported separately
protocol.snapshot_scope: /app task workspace only; service/OS state outside it is not rolled back
protocol.credential_policy: key entered only at launch; root-only volatile /run systemd credential; never in job JSON
